title: Connect Google
intro: Connect Calendar, Drive and Gmail using one Google account.
disconnectDescription: This removes the local credentials and stops pending reconnections. It does not revoke Google consent or undo completed operations.
notLiveVerified: Saved permissions do not verify live access to every resource. Google still enforces account policy and file eligibility.
operatorDescription: Ask a system administrator to configure the Google OAuth application. Application secrets are not entered here.
preparationUnverified: The application is configured locally. Live Google service access has not been verified.
selectDescription: Enable the services this Toolkit should use. Available actions depend on the actual permissions returned by Google, not only the access requested below.
agentOwnership: This connection belongs only to this Agent. Runs use this saved account, not a participant's account.
sharedOwnership: Workspace-shared connection: authorized users and Agents may act using this saved account.
personalOwnership: This connection belongs to your account. Only your personal Sessions with allowed Agents can use it.
actualPermissions: These are Google's actual returned permissions. A broader grant may enable more supported actions in an enabled service than the request labels suggest.
missingRenewal: No renewable credential was returned. This candidate cannot be saved; start a new explicit authorization.
name: Toolkit name
riskDescription: Messages, files and calendar content can contain misleading instructions. Treat their content as data, not authorization to perform another action.
noReplay: A missing or failed response can follow a completed Google write. Check the result instead of blindly repeating the operation.
unknownDescription: Check the exact attempt's result instead of saving again. You may discard the local attempt; if publication already won the race, its saved result is returned.
savedDescription: The reviewed grant is saved. Resource access still depends on Google permissions and policy.
superseded: This result is no longer current
supersededDescription: The attempt was saved earlier but another connection or disconnect replaced it.
availableActions: {count, plural, =0 {No authorized actions} one {# authorized action} other {# authorized actions}}
authorizationFailed: Unable to start Google authorization. The saved connection has not been replaced.
authorizationIncomplete: Authorization did not return a verified result. Discard this local attempt before starting again.
verificationFailed: The candidate is unavailable, expired, or could not be verified. No new connection was published.
verificationUncertain: The verification response was not received. Return to setup to inspect this attempt without exchanging the code again.
expired: This authorization attempt expired. Discard it and start a new one.
outcomeUnavailable: The final result is not available yet. Check again or discard the exact attempt; do not repeat the save blindly.
cancelFailed: Unable to discard the attempt. Keep this context and retry the same local cancellation.
disconnectFailed: The disconnect result is uncertain. Reload status before taking another action.
statusFailed: Unable to load this saved connection.
staleCallback: This callback does not match the active authorization context. No account was attached and no other attempt was cancelled.

requests.gmailModify: Read, organize, draft and send mail
requests.gmailSend: Send new mail without mailbox reads
requests.gmailMetadata: Read mail metadata, not message bodies
requests.gmailSettings: Manage filters — may affect future mail forwarding
requests.gmailFull: Broad Gmail access — supported actions only
requests.calendarCreate: Create secondary calendars and use app-created calendars
requests.calendarFull: Broad calendar access — supported actions only
requests.driveFull: Read and change files across Drive — including sharing and ownership where allowed
requests.driveRead: Read and export files across Drive
requests.driveAppFiles: Read and change app-authorized files — not read-only
requests.driveMetadata: Read and change file metadata across Drive

inactive: All services are off. The saved account and grant remain connected.
localServicesDescription: Save service switches locally without Google consent. Turning every service off keeps the saved connection.
serviceSaveFailed: The service-save result could not be confirmed. Review refreshed status before retrying.
requestAccessDescription: Changing these requests takes effect only through explicit Google reconnection. It does not restrict a broader actual grant. New Drive requests default to reading all accessible files. Choose write access explicitly.
driveWholeWrite: Change content across Drive; Google still checks each resource and action.
driveAppWrite: Write only app-created or Google-authorized app files, even when whole-Drive reads are also granted.
driveAppRead: Read only eligible app files. Selecting a folder does not authorize all descendants.
driveMetadataRead: Read metadata across Drive; this does not grant content reads.
driveMetadataWrite: Change metadata across Drive; this does not grant content writes.
pickerOperatorRequired: Ask an administrator to configure the optional Google Picker API key and project number. Other Google tools remain available.
pickerRequiresGrant: Picker requires a saved, renewable connection with Drive enabled and an actual drive.file grant. Save service changes or reconnect if needed.
pickerSelected: {count, plural, one {# file selected in Google} other {# files selected in Google}}. Google controls eligibility; this is not a local access list.
pickerCancelled: File selection closed without retaining a selection.
pickerFailed: Google file selection is unavailable. Reload the connection and check administrator preparation before trying again.
pickerExpired: The temporary file-selection credential expired. Open the chooser again for a new credential.
